title: serratula flavescens
intro: Serratula flavescens, commonly known as Yellow Milk Thistle, is a perennial plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support liver health and function, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Serratula flavescens are believed to be attributed to its ability to stimulate liver function, improve digestion, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
